utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay, is everyone on? Henrik, I can't hear you if you're talking.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Sorry, was on mute. I'm here.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Good. Before the budget thing, Salma needs brand deck comments by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Oh, yeah, I looked at it on the train, I didn't actually write anything down though, so-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Write it down today.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah. It's mostly fine, honestly, the second section drags a bit and the font on the pricing slide is, um-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Mateo. To Salma. Not to us.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Right. Fair.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Is that the one from the offsite? With the big framing slide?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Newer one.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Oh. Okay. I might be thinking of the other-

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: The one with the customer quotes.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: That's it, yes. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fine. Third quarter money. Greta, you had a view.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yeah. So, um - all of the hundred twenty, I'd just drop it into search ads and social ads and run that straight through the quarter.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: All of it? Like, nothing held back?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Nothing held back. That's the - that's what I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Huh. I mean, big picture that feels, um, a bit narrow? Like where's the brand-

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hang on, let me-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Sorry, go.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Last quarter search came in at about sixty-two a lead. The events were ninety-five.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: And the pipeline number for this quarter needs something like nineteen hundred leads, so we can't really afford the pricey ones.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Is the sixty-two the blended number or just search?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Just search. Social was a bit worse, I'd have to pull it up.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Okay. Because I remember social being closer to seventy.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Could be. Seventy-ish. Doesn't change it much.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Ninety-five for events though, that included the booth at the, uh, the Denver thing, right? Which, I mean, the booth alone-

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yeah, it included the booth.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Because Paolo told me the booth deposit was non-refundable, and that was like, what, eight grand?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Mateo, keep to the point.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I am, it's - it's cost per lead, the booth is in the cost.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Eight is close enough. Move on.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right, so if we take nineteen hundred leads at sixty-two, that's - what is that, a hundred and something thousand?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hundred seventeen-ish. Hundred eighteen.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay so it basically eats the whole budget.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Right. Which is sort of the point. It fits.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Does that leave anything for creative? Like the ad production?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Creative's out of the other line. Clara's team has that already.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Oh. Okay. I thought it came out of this.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: It doesn't. Clara has it.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I just, I worry we're all in on two things. If the algorithm changes or whatever.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Sure, and if it does we lose a month, not the quarter. I'm playing the other side a bit, but they're not locked contracts.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: That's true, the platforms bill monthly. Which reminds me, did anyone get that email from Rosa about the invoice thing?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Which invoice thing.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: The card reconciliation. Something about last month's ad charges showing up twice.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Forward it to me. I'll sort it with finance.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Will do. I think it's just a timing thing though, because Caio said the same happened in March.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Forward it anyway.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Okay, sorry, totally separate, but the Denver thing reminded me - the hotel they put me in had this, like, entire wall of vending machines instead of a restaurant-

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Mateo.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: -and the only thing in it was soup. Cold soup. I'm serious.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Wait, in cans?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: In cans! And no microwave on the floor.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: That's grim.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Are we done?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Done. Done.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Greta. Back to yours. Who watches the spend week to week?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: I would, with Emeka's dashboard. He built the pacing view in April.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Does it work?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Mostly. The social numbers lag a day or two.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I can help check it, if you want. Tuesdays are light for me.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: That'd be useful, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Good. Henrik, sort that between you two.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: And reporting up? Paolo's going to ask about it in the review.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Paolo asks about everything. We send the numbers monthly.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right. Fine. I just meant, the story we tell.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: The story is leads.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Sure, sure. Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: One more thing, since somebody should. What if it saturates? Like we double the spend and the lead cost creeps up.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yeah that's what I was gonna - I mean it usually does, right? The first bit's cheap, then-

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Right, so the sixty-two is probably optimistic at full volume. Say it goes to seventy-five, we're short on leads.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: How short?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: At seventy-five, the budget gets us - um, sixteen hundred. Give or take.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: That's a few hundred under.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yeah. So it's not clean. But the events are worse at any plausible number.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: And we can adjust in July if it drifts?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Monthly billing, so yes.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fine. Greta, get the media plan booked. Confirmation to me by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Will do. Do I send it through Caio or direct?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Direct. Caio's out till Monday anyway.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Is it too late to get the retrospective on the calendar? The spring campaign one?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Put it on for next week. Thursday, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Thursday's the deck day, no?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Then Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I'm out Wednesday afternoon. Morning is fine.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Morning then. Mateo, send the invite.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: On it.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Can I ask something unrelated? Who's covering the newsletter while Rosa's away?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Amara.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Me? Since when?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Since the schedule I sent last week.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Oh. I think that went to a folder somewhere. Okay, fine.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: It's just two issues.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Two. Okay. Is there a template?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Yes, I'll send you the link.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Thanks, Henrik. That's a relief, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Do we have lunch plans for the team thing in June or did that fall through?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Not my problem this week.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I can look into places. There's a Thai spot near the office that-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fine. Look.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Great, I'll- yeah.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Lakshmi, I might need an hour with you tomorrow for the plan details.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Ten o'clock.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Ten works.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I have a hard stop in two minutes, by the way.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Good. Go.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay, everyone here? Henrik, you're on this time, good.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Yep. Mic works today.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Morning. Sorry, one sec, I'm getting the door, the courier's been circling-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Mateo.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Back. Back now.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Retro invite went out for tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yes, ten o'clock. Sent Monday.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I did see it. I accepted, I think.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: You think.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I accepted. Okay, yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Good. Now, something landed from finance yesterday afternoon and it touches the third quarter plan.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Is this the part where my media plan gets rewritten?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Let me say it. Finance cut our third quarter marketing money by thirty-five percent. Hundred twenty goes to seventy-eight, and it's effective now.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Seventy-eight thousand. Wow.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: The launch slipped, so they're pulling cash back everywhere. Not just us.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Wait, so the launch isn't happening in July at all?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Not on the old date. That's all I know, and it's not our call.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hm. And the hundred twenty was already, you know, spoken for in my head. I'd only sent the first month's order so far.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fine, nothing's lost there. So here's the thing. I'm reopening the budget question. Search alone at seventy-eight buys us maybe twelve sixty leads, and we need nineteen hundred.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Twelve sixty at the sixty-two a lead.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Right. And you said yourself it creeps up when you push volume.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: I did say that. Okay, I'm not going to defend it at those numbers. Playing devil's advocate for a second though, twelve sixty is still twelve sixty.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: It's six hundred and something short of target.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yeah. Fair.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Is the nineteen hundred fixed? Or can sales live with fewer?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fixed for now. Paolo hasn't moved it, and I'm not going to ask him this week.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Can I ask what happened to the money, like where did it go, does it just disappear or-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Holds in finance until the launch has a date.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Right, right. That's a bit like at my last place, where they'd freeze everything the minute a ship date wobbled and then spend it all in one panicky week in December-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Mateo, the options.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Sorry. Yes. The options.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: So the other idea from last week, the one we all kind of pushed aside, the partner thing.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: The webinars. About fourteen each, three of them.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yeah. I keep thinking about it. The partners bring their own people, that's the whole appeal, we're not paying to find an audience from scratch.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: And last year we did one together with a partner, just the one, and it gave us around four hundred ten leads. For fourteen thousand.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Four ten. Out of one event?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: One event. Mm. So if you did three, that's, um, what, twelve hundred and thirty or so.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Twelve thirty, fine, if they all perform like the first one, which they won't necessarily.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Sure. But then the remainder goes to retargeting, so it's thirty-six thousand on top of the webinars-

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Seventy-eight minus forty-two, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right, that. And retargeting is people who've already seen us, so it's cheap. All in, I think it gets you close to the nineteen hundred.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Close is doing a lot of work in that sentence.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Close. It's close. Way closer than search on its own.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: How close on the retargeting side, Henrik, do you have last quarter's number?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I'd have to look. I remember it being cheaper than search by a fair bit. Maybe half?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Half is enough for me.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: I'd still want to know if the webinar audience isn't just the same people retargeting would hit anyway. Overlap.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Probably some. Not all.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: That's what I figured. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Right. The budget goes to three partner webinars plus retargeting. Search and social are out for this quarter's money.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Out entirely?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Entirely. If something changes we look again.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay. I'll cancel the first month's order, then.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Yes. Do it today.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Today. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Who finds the partners? That's three of them.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Amara has the relationships. Amara, who do you have?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Oh, um. There's the two from last year's conference list. And, I think, one more that Emeka mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Emeka knows a name?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I think he does. I'll ask him.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Names to me by Friday, even if it's two.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Friday. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: And dates? Because if the partners all pick the same week, we've got three webinars and one of me.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Spread them. One a month.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Perfect, that I can do.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Do we pay up front or after?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Clara's team handles the paperwork. I'll ask her.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Can I bring up the newsletter? It's small.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Go.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: So, since I'm covering for Rosa on the next two issues, I've been looking at the sender. Right now it comes from the company name. I'd like to send it from the content lead's name instead.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Like a person's name in the from line.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yes. A person.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Why, though? Company name looks official. People trust it.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: We did two test sends recently, with a named sender, and the open rate went up fourteen percent both times, or about that.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Both times. Hm. Is that the same list?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Same segment. I think so. Rosa set it up.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Fourteen's real money for a free channel.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, that's decent. I just wanted to hear it said out loud.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fine. The monthly newsletter goes out from the content lead's name starting with the next one.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Great. I'll tell Rosa when she's back, in case she has opinions.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: She won't. Moving on.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Quick calendar thing, the team lunch. I looked at the Thai place and they can't do a table of five on a Friday.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Pick another day.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Thursday, then? Except that's deck day.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Then not Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Wednesday? Amara's out the afternoon, so a lunch is maybe fine.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Lunch I can do. I leave around two.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Okay. Wednesday lunch it is, I'll book it.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Is that the same Wednesday as the retro?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Oh. Yes. The retro's the morning though, so, yeah, sequence is fine.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Don't make the retro a lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I would never.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Lakshmi, did you want the new plan written up, or is it enough that we all heard it?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Write it up. One page. Webinar dates, retargeting spend, owners.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: One page. When?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Early next week.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I can pull the retargeting numbers for it. Tonight, probably.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Do that, send to Greta.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I should say, the big thing for me is that this feels like the right shape, whatever the numbers turn out to be.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: The numbers matter.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Of course. Yes. They matter.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I've got another call. That's it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Bye all.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Everyone here? Okay. Amara, partner names. Did you get to three?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Um, two for sure. The two from the conference list both said yes in principle.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: In principle.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: They want to see a one-pager first. Topic, who's on stage, that kind of thing.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: And the third? Emeka's name?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Emeka gave me a company, but I haven't actually reached anyone there. I emailed a general address.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: A general address.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's the only one on the site. I'll find a person.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Try the events lead on their page. Usually there's one.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, Henrik. That's useful.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Can I ask about timing? Because if the first one's in July, that's like, three weeks, and the partners usually want a month of promo-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: That's why I asked for names.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Right, right. I'm just saying the promo window is tight for the first one. Not saying it can't work.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: What does a promo window even need? Emails, a landing page, and what else?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Landing page, two emails from each side, some social. The partner does their half.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Who builds the landing page?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Me, I guess. Unless Clara's team has a template.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Ask Clara.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Will do. She's been quiet since the reorg though, so I don't know who actually-

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Just ask her.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Did Clara ever answer about paying up front or after?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Not yet. I pinged her Monday.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Okay. I only ask because if it's half up front that changes when the money leaves.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: It does. I'll chase.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Retargeting side, Henrik, did you send me the numbers?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Last Thursday. Sorry, did it go to your other address?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Oh. Maybe. Hang on. Yes, I see it. It was in a folder.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: It's a rough view. Cost per lead on retargeting was around thirty-ish, but I'd treat that as a ballpark.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Thirty. So around half of search, like you said.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: A bit under half, I think.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, and that's with a small audience pool. If we put thirty-six thousand into it, the pool might be the limit.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Probably. I don't know how big the pool is, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: The pool grows once the webinars start, though. People register, they land on the list.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Sure, after. Not before.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Mm. True.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Greta, is the one-page plan done?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Draft. I have the webinar dates as blanks and the owners filled in. It's about two thirds there.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Send it when the blanks are filled.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: That's the problem, the blanks depend on partners.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Then send it with blanks. Friday.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Fine. With blanks.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Totally different thing - did anyone see the all-hands invite for Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I saw it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: It says "optional" but then there's a line saying product is presenting the new date. That doesn't sound optional.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Is that about the launch?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I assume. I'd go.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I'm going. Everyone should.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: What time?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Eleven. Wait, or eleven thirty.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: It's eleven. I have it in my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Eleven. Good.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I can do eleven.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Ha, funny, the all-hands reminds me. At my first job we had an all-hands in a bowling alley, because the office was being painted, and the CEO is giving a speech while the lanes behind him are still going-

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Mateo.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: -and there's a strike in the middle of the sentence about quarterly targets, and everyone just kind of, you know, stands there-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Did people clap?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Some people clapped. The CEO did not take it well.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Oh no.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Are we done with the bowling alley?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: We're done. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay. Newsletter. Did the sender change go through on the last issue?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It went out this morning. From the content lead's name.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Any complaints?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Nothing yet. I got one reply, someone asking if they could reply to the person. Which, they can.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: See, that's a thing. Replies go to a real inbox now.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It goes to a shared one. Rosa set it up that way, I think.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: You think.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's a shared one. I checked. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: When's Rosa back, by the way?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: The twentieth. Or the twenty-third. One of those.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: The twenty-third.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay, the twenty-third.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: So there's one more issue for you after this one.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right. Then I'm done. Thank goodness.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: It's not that bad.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's not bad. It's just I keep forgetting it exists.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Mateo, what's with the retro notes? You said you'd write them up.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I have them. Mostly. There's a section on the spring campaign where I just wrote "see Greta."

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: What does that mean?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: You had a point about the landing page and I didn't catch the details.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: I don't remember saying that.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: You did, it was near the end, we were all kind of leaving-

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Then send me what you have and I'll fill it in.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Perfect.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Today.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Today.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Can I say something about the plan? Not the numbers. Just, um, the framing.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Go.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: When Paolo asks about it in the review, I think the story is more than leads. It's, like, we built partner relationships we didn't have before.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Paolo asks about leads.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: He does. But the second thing he'll ask is what we have after the quarter. And the partners are something.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: That's fair, actually. Search leaves you nothing when you stop paying.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Put a line in the one-pager. One line.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I can write the line.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Give it to Greta.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I need to drop in a minute, I've got a, uh- a thing at noon.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Fine. Anything for Henrik before he goes?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Just the Tuesday check-in. Is that still happening?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: There's nothing to pace anymore, is there? The ad spend's not running.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Not yet. Retargeting will be.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Right. Then later. I'll keep it free.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay. Go, Henrik.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Thanks. Bye.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Mateo, lunch. Wednesday booked?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Booked, one o'clock, the Thai place. They gave us a table of five.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Good. That's it.
